claim: Ti2 Control must be installed before the microscope is connected to the computer by USB, or the driver may not install and the microscope may not be recognised; and the USB cable to the microscope must not be unplugged once Ti2 Control is running.
validity_conditions: Read from Nikon Ti2 Control Ver2.90 for Windows, English manual M706 E15 (sha256 5e43517c...): printed page 2 (PDF page 10), printed page 3 (PDF page 11), printed page 6 (PDF page 14). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. This manual is for the Ti2 Control software; the archive holds no Ti2-E hardware manual. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
